info.name: TaskFlow Backend - E2E
info.description:
End-to-end functional tests for the TaskFlow backend.

PREREQUISITES
1. Backend running on {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:8080/api/v1).
2. Seed data loaded so a global ADMIN and the skill catalogue exist:
   ./mvnw spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=seed
   (admin@taskflow.dev / password123)

HOW TO RUN
- Postman: pick the 'TaskFlow - Local' environment, then Run collection (keep folder order, iterations = 1).
- Newman:  newman run postman/TaskFlow.postman_collection.json -e postman/TaskFlow.postman_environment.json

The collection is self-chaining: it registers fresh member users (a+{{runId}}@tf.test ...), creates its own project with a random key, exercises the full flow, then restores the assignment config. Re-runnable without cleanup.
